records.title: ORGANA: A Robotic Assistant for Automated Chemistry Experimentation and Characterization
records.reason: Chemistry experiments can be resource- and labor-intensive, often requiring manual tasks like polishing electrodes in electrochemistry. Traditional lab automation infrastructure faces challenges adapting to new experiments. To address this, we introduce ORGANA, an assistive robotic system that automates diverse chemistry experiments using decision-making and perception tools. It makes decisions with chemists in the loop to control robots and lab devices. ORGANA interacts with chemists using Large Language Models (LLMs) to derive experiment goals, handle disambiguation, and provide experiment logs. ORGANA plans and executes complex tasks with visual feedback, while supporting scheduling and parallel task execution. We demonstrate ORGANA's capabilities in solubility, pH measurement, recrystallization, and electrochemistry experiments. In electrochemistry, it executes a 19-step plan in parallel to characterize quinone derivatives for flow batteries. Our user study shows ORGANA reduces frustration and physical demand by over 50%, with users saving an average of 80.3% of their time when using it.

records.title: Goedel-Prover-V2: Scaling Formal Theorem Proving with Scaffolded Data Synthesis and Self-Correction
records.reason: Goedel-Prover-V2 combines scaffolded data, verifier feedback and self-correction; reports an 8B prover exceeding a 671B model on MiniF2F and performance at small test-time budgets. The gains are theorem-proving-specific, not general serving optimization.

records.title: See What You Are Told: Visual Attention Sink in Large Multimodal Models
records.reason: Visual Attention Redistribution studies irrelevant high-activation visual sink tokens and reallocates attention to image-relevant tokens. Experiments target visual quality; no token/cache compression or latency reduction is reported, making adaptive KV-cache lineage weak.

records.title: RCAgent: Cloud Root Cause Analysis by Autonomous Agents with Tool-Augmented Large Language Models
records.reason: Large language model (LLM) applications in cloud root cause analysis (RCA) have been actively explored recently. However, current methods are still reliant on manual workflow settings and do not unleash LLMs' decision-making and environment interaction capabilities. We present RCAgent, a tool-augmented LLM autonomous agent framework for practical and privacy-aware industrial RCA usage. Running on an internally deployed model rather than GPT families, RCAgent is capable of free-form data collection and comprehensive analysis with tools. Our framework combines a variety of enhancements, including a unique Self-Consistency for action trajectories, and a suite of methods for context management, stabilization, and importing domain knowledge. Our experiments show RCAgent's evident and consistent superiority over ReAct across all aspects of RCA--predicting root causes, solutions, evidence, and responsibilities--and tasks covered or uncovered by current rules, as validated by both automated metrics and human evaluations. Furthermore, RCAgent has already been integrated into the diagnosis and issue discovery workflow of the Real-time Compute Platform for Apache Flink of Alibaba Cloud.

records.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Foundation Models in Medicine
records.reason: Medical foundation-model survey mentions efficient training/inference and cloud deployment as future needs, but evaluates no serving scheduler or concrete inference optimization; cached-serving relation is application context.
